files.purpose: enum DeepSeekAPI is the non-streaming HTTP client for api.deepseek.com that the provider registry and the usage panel call; chat streaming lives in DeepSeekSession. It holds the four endpoint URLs (base https://api.deepseek.com, /chat/completions, /models, /user/balance), key validation, the model catalog fetch, the prepaid-balance read and its parsing into ProviderCredits (string amounts, first balance_infos entry only, is_available defaulting to true). It also owns DeepSeek's static model knowledge: efforts [low, high, max], the 1,048,576-token context window, option(for:) (deepseek-v4-pro 'V4 Pro' default, deepseek-flash 'V4.1 Flash', four retired ids hidden, any other id passed through under its own id) and isVisionModel for the three Flash ids. At B3 validate and listModels are one-line delegations to the new shared OpenAICompatibleAPI, and balance builds its request with OpenAICompatibleAPI.bearerRequest.

files.purpose: enum MetaAPI is the lightweight client for Meta's OpenAI-compatible Muse Spark API at https://api.meta.ai/v1, used by the registry for key validation and the model catalog, while MetaSession does the chat streaming over /v1/chat/completions (the header comment explains why the Responses API is not used). It fixes the base, chat and models URLs, the 1,048,576-token context window and 131,072 max output tokens, and the per-model effort ladder: only muse-spark-1.3 gets 'max' (probed 2026-09-13); every other model gets minimal..xhigh. It also defines the five named Spark catalog rows with their detail strings, a muse-spark prefix rule that drops non-chat models such as muse-image-1.0 and muse-voice-transcribe-1.0, and treats every Spark model, and a nil or empty id, as vision-capable. At B3 validate and listModels delegate to the new OpenAICompatibleAPI.

files.purpose: OpenAICompatibleSession is the one @MainActor ProviderSession implementation behind the DeepSeek, Meta and Z.ai native API providers. Subclasses supply a Config (kind, title, agentIdentity, defaultModel, chatURL, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, replaysReasoning, isVisionModel) and override applyProviderPayload, reasoningEffort(for:model:) and friendlyError. It runs the whole agent loop: the system prompt (mode line, Hydra fallback policy, anti-slop policy, project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md guidance, today's ISO date), SSE streaming through a detached drain and a 30 ms StreamCoalescer actor, two transport retries at 1 s and 2 s for networkConnectionLost, timedOut and cannotConnectToHost, and the six built-in tools (read_file, list_files, search_text, write_file, edit_file, run_command) plus MCPHub tools. It also runs up to four concurrent approval-free reads, raises approvals with 'Approve' / 'Approve for turn' / 'Decline', and keeps the plan-mode block ahead of approve-for-turn. It applies the Hydra head wrap-up, pacing and final-report budget, condenses history (160,000 bytes down to 100,000, keeping the last 10 results whole), trims it above 60 messages, repairs tool-call chains, and stops a turn at a 200-round ceiling.

files.purpose: ProviderSession.swift is the provider-neutral contract every CLI, ACP and API adapter implements. It defines TurnInput (one turn's request), SessionConfiguration (launch settings, including apiKey, hydra, transcript replay, isHydraHead and antiSlopEnabled), TranscriptMessage, AgentSpawn, the 31-case ProviderEvent stream normalized into a thread, and ToolUpdate. It also defines the @MainActor ProviderSession protocol (onEvent, isRunning, start, send, interrupt, resolveApproval, answerQuestion, compact, stop, stopAgent with a default of false), ProviderError with its user-facing messages, and the ToolTitles helpers (unwrapShell, relativePath, diffStats). At B3 it also hosts two helpers taken out of individual sessions: ToolText.blocks, which reads the text of a string or content-block array, and ApprovalRequest.Kind.grantKey, the key an 'approve for session' grant is stored under.

files.purpose: enum ZaiAPI is the lightweight client for Z.ai's GLM Coding Plan (https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4), used for key validation, the model catalog and the Coding Plan usage features; ZaiSession does the chat streaming. It offers only glm-5.3 ids, never GLM-5.3-FlashX, with efforts [low, high, max] defaulting to max, a 1,000,000-token context and 128,000 max output tokens, and treats ids containing 'flash' or ending in 'v' as vision models. Plan limits come from the monitor quota endpoint as CREDIT_LIMIT/TOKENS_LIMIT windows titled from unit codes, plus a 'Monthly · MCP tools' TIME_LIMIT window. It also reads reset cards from customer-package-reset/list and spends one through customer-package-reset/use followed by a two-second wait. Card expiries are parsed as naive Asia/Shanghai 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss', and counts are formatted with en_US grouping. At B3 validate and listModels delegate to OpenAICompatibleAPI, planLimits builds its request with OpenAICompatibleAPI.bearerRequest, and the reset-date DateFormatter is cached in a static.
